title: Why can't I send money to this contact?
summary: Explains common reasons you can’t send money to a specific contact: the contact isn’t verified (your account needs verification before the first transaction), you’ve blocked/unblocked them, invalid/inactive contact info, the recipient can’t receive payments, or a temporary security review restriction. Lists steps to resolve: verify in the contact card, confirm username/email/mobile, check and unblock from your block list, retry later for temporary restrictions, and contact support with failed transaction details.
faqs: Why does it say I can’t send money to this contact?
